theorems.name: begin_requires_token_and_fit
theorems.doc: **S (U1, U3).** An upload starts only with no upload running, the token, a declared length, and an image that fits the active slot.
theorems.statement:
theorem begin_requires_token_and_fit (cur : Session) (a h : Bool) (len : Std.U32) (s : Session)
    (hb : begin cur a h len = ok (some s)) :
    cur.active = false ∧ a = true ∧ h = true ∧ 0 < len.val ∧ len.val ≤ 876 * 1024 ∧
      s.active = true ∧ s.written.val = 0 ∧ s.declared = len
theorems.proof:
theorem begin_requires_token_and_fit (cur : Session) (a h : Bool) (len : Std.U32) (s : Session)
    (hb : begin cur a h len = ok (some s)) :
    cur.active = false ∧ a = true ∧ h = true ∧ 0 < len.val ∧ len.val ≤ 876 * 1024 ∧
      s.active = true ∧ s.written.val = 0 ∧ s.declared = len := by
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hp⟩ := (WP.spec_equiv_exists _ _).1 (begin_spec cur a h len)
  rw [hb] at hr
  simp only [Result.ok.injEq] at hr
  exact hp s hr.symm

theorems.name: chunk_within_declared
theorems.doc: **S (U2).** A chunk is accepted only within the declared length.
theorems.statement:
theorem chunk_within_declared (s : Session) (n : Std.U32) (off : Std.U32) (s' : Session)
    (hinv : s.written.val ≤ s.declared.val) (h : chunk s n = ok (some (off, s'))) :
    s'.written.val ≤ s'.declared.val ∧ s'.declared = s.declared ∧ s'.active = true
theorems.proof:
theorem chunk_within_declared (s : Session) (n : Std.U32) (off : Std.U32) (s' : Session)
    (hinv : s.written.val ≤ s.declared.val) (h : chunk s n = ok (some (off, s'))) :
    s'.written.val ≤ s'.declared.val ∧ s'.declared = s.declared ∧ s'.active = true := by
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hp⟩ := (WP.spec_equiv_exists _ _).1 (chunk_spec s n hinv)
  rw [h] at hr
  simp only [Result.ok.injEq] at hr
  obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3, _, _⟩ := hp off s' hr.symm
  exact ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩

theorems.name: chunk_contiguous
theorems.doc: **S (U2).** Chunks are written contiguously: each at the bytes written so far, which then grow by its length.
theorems.statement:
theorem chunk_contiguous (s : Session) (n : Std.U32) (off : Std.U32) (s' : Session)
    (hinv : s.written.val ≤ s.declared.val) (h : chunk s n = ok (some (off, s'))) :
    off = s.written ∧ s'.written.val = s.written.val + n.val
theorems.proof:
theorem chunk_contiguous (s : Session) (n : Std.U32) (off : Std.U32) (s' : Session)
    (hinv : s.written.val ≤ s.declared.val) (h : chunk s n = ok (some (off, s'))) :
    off = s.written ∧ s'.written.val = s.written.val + n.val := by
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hp⟩ := (WP.spec_equiv_exists _ _).1 (chunk_spec s n hinv)
  rw [h] at hr
  simp only [Result.ok.injEq] at hr
  obtain ⟨_, _, _, h4, h5⟩ := hp off s' hr.symm
  exact ⟨h4, h5⟩

theorems.name: complete_iff_all_written
theorems.doc: **S.** An image is marked for swap exactly when all its declared bytes were written.
theorems.statement:
theorem complete_iff_all_written (s : Session) :
    complete s = ok (s.active && decide (s.written = s.declared) && decide (0 < s.declared.val))
theorems.proof:
theorem complete_iff_all_written (s : Session) :
    complete s = ok (s.active && decide (s.written = s.declared) && decide (0 < s.declared.val)) := by
  unfold complete
  cases ha : s.active <;> simp
  split_ifs with hw <;> simp_all <;> scalar_tac

theorems.name: abort_never_completes
theorems.doc: **S (U3).** An aborted session is never marked.
theorems.statement: theorem abort_never_completes (s : Session) : (do let t ← abort s; complete t) = ok false
theorems.proof:
theorem abort_never_completes (s : Session) : (do let t ← abort s; complete t) = ok false := by
  first
    | rfl
    | (simp only [abort, bind_tc_ok]; unfold complete IDLE; simp)
    | decide

theorems.name: token_ok_needs_configured
theorems.doc: **S (U1).** With no token configured (all zero), no request is authorised.
theorems.statement:
theorem token_ok_needs_configured (g : Array Std.U8 32#usize) :
    token_ok g (Array.repeat 32#usize 0#u8) = ok false
theorems.proof:
theorem token_ok_needs_configured (g : Array Std.U8 32#usize) :
    token_ok g (Array.repeat 32#usize 0#u8) = ok false := by
  have spec : token_ok g (Array.repeat 32#usize 0#u8) ⦃ r => r = false ⦄ := by
    unfold token_ok
    have hl := token_ok_loop_zero g 0#u8 0#usize (by simp)
    step*
    all_goals first | (simp_all; done) | (split <;> simp_all) | scalar_tac
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hp⟩ := (WP.spec_equiv_exists _ _).1 spec
  rw [hr, hp]

theorems.name: confirm_boot_needs_up
theorems.doc: **S (U4).** A swapped-in image is confirmed only once the firmware is up.
theorems.statement:
theorem confirm_boot_needs_up (sw up : Bool) (h : confirm_boot sw up = ok true) :
    sw = true ∧ up = true
theorems.proof:
theorem confirm_boot_needs_up (sw up : Bool) (h : confirm_boot sw up = ok true) :
    sw = true ∧ up = true := by
  unfold confirm_boot at h
  cases sw <;> cases up <;> simp_all

abort.lean:
def abort (_s : Session) : Result Session := do
  ok IDLE
abort.upstream_note: write-failure paths back to 'outer; upstream has no abort on disconnect (res? returns, init_dfu keeps the offset: U3)

Session.lean:
structure Session where
  active : Bool
  declared : Std.U32
  written : Std.U32
Session.upstream_note: init_dfu's upload state (the offset local); the port adds the declared Content-Length and an active flag

confirm_boot.lean:
def confirm_boot (state_is_swap : Bool) (up : Bool) : Result Bool := do
  if state_is_swap
  then ok up
  else ok false
confirm_boot.upstream_note: upstream never calls mark_booted (U4); the port confirms where main has brought up the web server

token_ok.lean:
def token_ok
  (given : Array Std.U8 32#usize) (configured : Array Std.U8 32#usize) :
  Result Bool
  := do
  let (diff, any) ← token_ok_loop given configured 0#u8 0#u8 0#usize
  if diff = 0#u8
  then ok (any != 0#u8)
  else ok false
token_ok.upstream_note: upstream has no check (U1); guards POST /dfu (DfuUpdateEndpoint), which accepts a body from any client

IDLE.kernel_code: pub const IDLE: Session = Session { active: false, declared: 0, written: 0 };
IDLE.lean:
@[global_simps, irreducible]
def IDLE : Session := { active := false, declared := 0#u32, written := 0#u32 }
IDLE.upstream_note: init_dfu at the top of 'outer, waiting for the first bytes of an upload

begin.lean:
def begin
  (current : Session) (authorised : Bool) (has_length : Bool) (len : Std.U32) :
  Result (Option Session)
  := do
  if current.active
  then ok none
  else
    if authorised
    then
      if has_length
      then
        if len > 0#u32
        then
          let i ← ACTIVE_SIZE
          if len <= i
          then ok (some { active := true, declared := len, written := 0#u32 })
          else ok none
        else ok none
      else ok none
    else ok none
begin.upstream_note: start of an upload: endpoint begins streaming, init_dfu prepare_update + first write; upstream has no single-session/length check (U3)

chunk.lean:
def chunk
  (s : Session) (n : Std.U32) : Result (Option (Std.U32 × Session)) := do
  if s.active
  then
    if n > 0#u32
    then
      let i ← s.declared - s.written
      if n <= i
      then
        let i1 ← s.written + n
        ok (some (s.written, { s with written := i1 }))
      else ok none
    else ok none
  else ok none
chunk.upstream_note: flash.write(offset, ..) then offset += read; upstream writes the whole buffer (U2) and never bounds offset

upstream.code:
FLASH                             : ORIGIN = 0x1000b000, LENGTH = 876K
  DFU                               : ORIGIN = 0x100e6000, LENGTH = 880K

ACTIVE_SIZE.upstream_note: FLASH (active slot) 876K; the DFU partition is one page larger

complete.lean:
def complete (s : Session) : Result Bool := do
  if s.active
  then if s.written = s.declared
       then ok (s.declared > 0#u32)
       else ok false
  else ok false
